name: Grand Forks AFB
description: Home of the 319th Reconnaissance Wing. Grand Forks AFB operates RQ-4 Global Hawk missions and provides critical ISR support from the northern plains.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate.

gates.name: Main Gate
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate with Visitor Control Center (Bldg 812). After-hours visitors report to Main Gate Bldg 144.
gates.address: Main Gate, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 812)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; closed federal holidays, down days, and family days
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. Phone: 701-747-3587.

gates.name: Commercial (South) Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0600-1900; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.address: Highway 2 east side, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

gates.name: Eielson School Gate
gates.notes: Limited weekday access on County Rd 3 north of Main Gate.
gates.address: County Rd 3, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Airey Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Campus-style DFAC with Kitchen, Fire & Iron grill, Wrap It Up subs, Ciao Pizza, Greenhouse Salad Bar, Grab-N-Go, and Restaurant Rotation.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Breakfast 0600-0900, Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1830; Sat-Sun: Breakfast 0630-0830, Lunch 1030-1330, Dinner 1630-1830
resources.address: 649 John Marshall St, Bldg 315, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Grand Forks Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Grand Forks Main Exchange with food court, barber, beauty shop, optical, and shoppette.
resources.address: 550 Holzapple St, Bldg 105, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Grand Forks AFB Commissary
resources.description: Defense Commissary Agency full-service grocery with CLICK2GO curbside pickup.
resources.address: 380 Warrior Dr, Bldg 241, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Service Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union on base with deposit accounts, loans, and ATM.
resources.address: 589 Holzapple St, Bldg 210, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: 319th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services. After-hours urgent care available.

resources.name: Grand Forks Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, indoor pool, and sports amenities. 24/7 access for registered CAC holders.
resources.hours: Staffed Mon-Fri; 24/7 CAC access after registration at front desk
resources.address: Bldg 308, Tuskegee Airman Blvd, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Housing Management Office
resources.description: On-base privatized housing (Grand Forks AFB Homes) and off-base housing referrals.
resources.address: 514 Louisiana St, Bldg 119, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing Management Office
resources.description: Dormitory management for 344 one-plus-one rooms across four dormitories. Sponsor must contact before arrival.

resources.name: Warrior Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100
resources.address: 632 Holzapple St, Bldg 117, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.
resources.address: 575 Holzapple St, Bldg 207, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: 319th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation
resources.description: Equipment rental, golf ball machine, hunting/fishing licenses, FamCamp, and recreational programs. Call ahead for appointment access when staffing limited.
resources.address: 784 Eielson St, Bldg 621, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Dakota Lanes Bowling Center
resources.description: 24 traditional lanes, 8 Hyperbowling lanes, sports simulator, and Strike Zone Snack Bar.
resources.address: 529 Holzapple St, Bldg 202, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Plainsview Golf Course
resources.description: On-base 18-hole golf course with pro shop.
resources.address: 641 Alert Ave, Bldg 811, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.description: Visitor passes and base access. REAL ID required.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 812)
primaryAction.address: 80 Steen Blvd, Bldg 812, Grand Forks AFB, ND 58205

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Warrior Inn (701-747-7200) for initial arrival. UH Management Office (701-747-3116) for dorms — sponsor must coordinate before arrival. Family housing through Housing Office (701-747-3035).

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 319 FSS, M&FRC, and official Grand Forks sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
